scope: Connect explicit per-profile sensitive-answer policies to profile editing and reviewed per-application answer preparation.
behavior_verified: A profile can save explicit policies for the supported sensitive categories and the settings survive durable profile readback.
The application answer flow classifies supported questions and returns only that active profile's explicit policy; unsupported or unrecognized questions fail closed.
A configured response is visibly attributed to profile configuration and remains blank in the application answer field until the user chooses to use it.
Using a proposed response does not mark it reviewed; export remains gated on per-application review.
Sensitive configured text does not enter the reusable Answer Bank, and profile selection is enforced at the API boundary.
Policy changes do not trigger irrelevant job-match refreshes.

tests.detail: 17 tests passed, including local Chromium workflow and no-side-effect/profile-isolation checks.
TypeScript check and Vite production build passed.
Passed on the integrated source change.

limitations: Broader semantic question classification, complete legal-field coverage, and durable unsaved application-answer drafts remain incomplete.
PostgreSQL and live production ATS behavior were not exercised.
Hosted checks and hosted review are NOT_RUN_BY_POLICY; external submission remains OFF.
